name: Actual Budget (loot-core: budget sheet, register, reports)
param_style: AQL query builder compiled to SQL with values inlined as literals (no binds); raw loot-core SQL strings built with template literals
schema_source: packages/loot-core/default-db.sqlite (init.sql) with all 60 migrations applied (SQL and JS) and the views from makeViews(schema, schemaConfig), dumped from the migrated database
data_scale: scale 1: 8 years (2018-11 .. 2026-10), ~61.5k transactions rows (57k plain, 1.1k split parents with 2.7k children, 900 transfer pairs, 14 starting balances, ~1 % tombstoned; density rising towards today; Visa, Checking and Amex hold ~75 %), 14 accounts, 80 categories in 10 groups, 150 payees (Zipf use) + 20 merged + 14 transfer payees, 7.3k zero_budgets and 7.3k reflect_budgets rows, 129 rules, 9 schedules. Issue reporters run 10k-33k transactions over ~10 years.
visibility_note: 30k stars; local-first: the whole budget is a SQLite file queried on the user's device (sql.js/absurd-sql in browsers and phones, better-sqlite3 in the desktop app and server)
interest_note: AQL compiles every read into 3-4 nested views (v_transactions_internal -> _alive, category/payee mapping joins) plus up to 5 LEFT JOINs; month/year transforms become CAST(SUBSTR(date,...)) that no index serves; reports GROUP BY 5 keys with ORDER BY on non-grouped columns; register paging via GROUP_CONCAT + literal IN lists; running balances as SUM() OVER ... UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING over the whole account.
reach_note: widely self-hosted plus desktop/mobile web users; SQLite is the only storage and every query runs client-side

cpu_evidence.summary: Budget load and adding/removing a category stall 10-20 s (load ~15 s) with >10 accounts and a few thousand to 23k transactions over ~10 years; every sum-amount cell (category x month) is recomputed
33k-transaction budget (2014-2025) nearly impossible to edit; register refreshes take 10-15 s in browsers, reproduced with a 30k-transaction file
Missing acct index: running balance window query 802 ms -> 10 ms, per-account balance sums ~68 ms -> 5 ms, schedule matching 613 ms -> 19 ms (sql.js, 4x CPU throttle, 37.6 MB budget)
Multi-year budgets slow to open, worst on mobile: one SUM per category per month replaced by one grouped sum_amounts_by_month query on a cold build
Large budget (accounts >3000 transactions each): balance calculation per previewed transaction made schedule previews take ~5 s instead of <100 ms

analyze_note: ANALYZE only runs once, in an early migration on an empty database, so real installs plan with no useful statistics.
